units.source_text: “是呵，有个年轻人受坏孩子引诱，跑到了城里……

en.t: Yes, there was a young man who was led astray by bad kids and ran off to the city...

units.source_text: 那时，还舞刀弄枪，报纸上都登了出来……

en.t: At the time, he was even waving knives and guns around, and it all made the newspapers...

units.source_text: 刑期一到，立刻被人带了回来，眼下平平安安地和父母生活在一起……”

en.t: As soon as his sentence was up, he was brought straight back, and now he is living safe and sound with his parents..."
